# Comfy

> Comfy is the AI creation engine for visual professionals who demand control over every model, every parameter, and every output. Built around ComfyUI, the open-source node-graph runtime with 60,000+ community nodes, Comfy ships as a free desktop app, a managed cloud, an API, an MCP server and CLI for AI agents, and an enterprise platform.

The Comfy ecosystem spans these surfaces:

- **Comfy Desktop (local)**: the open-source ComfyUI engine, running models on your own hardware.
- **Comfy Cloud**: managed ComfyUI in the browser, with pre-loaded models, pre-installed custom nodes, and concurrent jobs.
- **Comfy API**: any ComfyUI workflow deployed as a production endpoint, triggered from your own apps and pipelines.
- **Comfy MCP**: the full ComfyUI engine exposed over the Model Context Protocol, so any AI agent can build workflows and generate images, video, audio, and 3D.
- **Comfy CLI**: the same engine from the terminal and from coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, with JSON output for scripts.
- **Comfy Enterprise**: ComfyUI for teams, with dedicated GPU compute, SSO and role-based access, bring-your-own API keys, and custom SLAs.
- **Comfy Developer Platform** (platform.comfy.org): API keys, usage, builds, and serverless deployments for developers.

Studios, brands, and schools building with Comfy include Series Entertainment, Moment Factory, Ubisoft La Forge, Groove Jones, Svedka with Silverside AI, and the Open Story Movement. Carnegie Mellon, USC, NTU, and UAL's Creative Computing Institute teach with ComfyUI. Use cases concentrate in VFX and animation, advertising and creative studios, gaming, and eCommerce and fashion.

Languages: comfy.org is published in English and Simplified Chinese. Nearly every page has a twin under /zh-CN/ (for example https://comfy.org/zh-CN/cli/); the affiliate, MSA, and supported-models directory pages are English only. Comfy Workflows is published in 11 languages (English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Español, Français, 日本語, 한국어, Português, Русский, العربية, and Türkçe). The docs are published in English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

For agents: every docs.comfy.org page serves markdown when you append `.md` to its URL, and the docs publish their own index (https://docs.comfy.org/llms.txt) and full text (https://docs.comfy.org/llms-full.txt). The developer platform describes itself in the same format (https://platform.comfy.org/llms.txt), the Comfy API is specified by an OpenAPI document (https://api.comfy.org/openapi), and the full list of pages on this site is in the sitemap (https://comfy.org/sitemap-index.xml).

## Product

- [Homepage](https://comfy.org/): Overview of Comfy, the AI creation engine for visual professionals, built on the open-source ComfyUI node graph.
- [Comfy Desktop](https://comfy.org/download/): Free desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux that runs the full ComfyUI engine on your own GPU.
- [Comfy Cloud](https://comfy.org/cloud/): Managed ComfyUI in the browser with pre-loaded models, pre-installed custom nodes, and concurrent jobs; no local install required. The app itself runs at https://cloud.comfy.org (sign-in required).
- [Comfy Cloud Pricing](https://comfy.org/cloud/pricing/): Plans, credits, and what each Comfy Cloud plan includes, for individuals and teams.
- [Comfy API](https://comfy.org/api/): Turn any ComfyUI workflow into a production endpoint: submit jobs, inject dynamic inputs at runtime, and run open and partner models through one API on Comfy Cloud.
- [Comfy MCP](https://comfy.org/mcp/): The full ComfyUI engine over the Model Context Protocol, so Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and any MCP client can build workflows and generate images, video, audio, and 3D, on Comfy Cloud or your own machine.
- [Comfy CLI](https://comfy.org/cli/): The command line for the ComfyUI engine: generate images, video, audio, and 3D from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any shell, with JSON output built for agents and scripts.
- [Comfy Enterprise](https://comfy.org/cloud/enterprise/): ComfyUI for teams: dedicated GPU compute, priority queuing, custom SLAs, team workspaces with role-based access and SSO, bring-your-own API keys, and models cleared for commercial use.
- [Forward Deployed Creatives](https://comfy.org/forward-deployed-creatives/): Comfy experts who embed with your team, build your ComfyUI workflows, and teach your team to scale them.
- [MiniMax Commercial License](https://comfy.org/minimax/license/): Commercial-use licenses for running MiniMax H3 and MiniMax Audio & Music locally; Comfy is the only official reseller, with Professional and Enterprise tiers.
- [Launches](https://comfy.org/launches/): Everything new in ComfyUI in one place: the latest launches across desktop, cloud, and the core engine.

## Models

- [Supported Models](https://comfy.org/p/supported-models/): Directory of 380+ models that run in ComfyUI: image, video, audio, 3D, and utility models, each with its own page.
- [Models Overview](https://comfy.org/models/): Flagship models available on Comfy, with links to each launch page.
- [Flux 3](https://comfy.org/flux-3/): Black Forest Labs' multimodal model: video with native audio, up to 20 seconds per generation, from text, image, video, or keyframes.
- [Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash](https://comfy.org/gemini-omni/): Google's video model on Comfy: one node covers text to video, image to video, reference to video, editing, and scene extension, with output up to 4K and audio on every clip.
- [LTX 2.5](https://comfy.org/ltx-2.5/): Open-weight video model: free to run on your own GPU, or on Comfy Cloud alongside every other model.
- [MiniMax H3](https://comfy.org/minimax-h3/): Open-weight video model: multi-modal in and out, native stereo audio on every clip, up to 2K and 5-15s per generation.
- [MiniMax Music 3](https://comfy.org/minimax-music-3/): Open-weight text-to-music model, on Comfy Cloud or your own GPU.
- [Seedance 2.5](https://comfy.org/seedance-2.5/): ByteDance's cinematic video model: multi-shot video with native audio, from text or image.
- [Wan 3.0](https://comfy.org/wan-3.0/): Up to 30 seconds of video from a text prompt, an image, or video, image, and audio references, with sound produced alongside the picture, on Comfy Cloud.
- [Wan Animate 2](https://comfy.org/wan-animate-2/): Open-source character animation: transfers motion from a driving video onto your character, on Comfy Cloud or your own hardware.

## Developers and Documentation

- [ComfyUI Docs](https://docs.comfy.org/): Official documentation for installing, configuring, and extending ComfyUI; every page also serves markdown at its URL plus `.md`.
- [Docs index for agents](https://docs.comfy.org/llms.txt): Machine-readable index of the full documentation.
- [Comfy CLI docs](https://docs.comfy.org/agent-tools/cli): Install comfy-cli, connect it to Comfy Cloud or a local ComfyUI, and run workflows from the terminal or a coding agent.
- [Comfy CLI reference](https://docs.comfy.org/comfy-cli/reference): Every comfy-cli command, flag, and JSON envelope.
- [Comfy MCP docs](https://docs.comfy.org/agent-tools/mcp): Connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients to ComfyUI; the hosted server endpoint is https://cloud.comfy.org/mcp.
- [Comfy SDKs](https://docs.comfy.org/development/api-development/sdks): Official Python and TypeScript SDKs for running ComfyUI workflows from your own application.
- [Comfy Cloud API](https://docs.comfy.org/development/cloud/overview): Trigger ComfyUI workflows from your own code on Comfy Cloud.
- [Serverless API](https://docs.comfy.org/development/serverless/overview): Build a versioned ComfyUI environment, deploy it as a managed endpoint, and run workflows through the API.
- [Getting an API key](https://docs.comfy.org/development/api-development/getting-an-api-key): Create and manage the Comfy Platform API key used by the API, the CLI, and the MCP server.
- [Comfy Developer Platform](https://platform.comfy.org/): Signed-in dashboard for API keys, usage and run history, builds, and serverless deployments; described for agents at https://platform.comfy.org/llms.txt.
- [Comfy API OpenAPI spec](https://api.comfy.org/openapi): OpenAPI specification for api.comfy.org.
- [Supported Nodes on Comfy Cloud](https://comfy.org/cloud/supported-nodes/): 120+ custom-node packs preinstalled on Comfy Cloud, searchable by pack or by node name.
- [Custom node development](https://docs.comfy.org/custom-nodes/overview): How ComfyUI custom nodes work and how to build one.
- [Comfy Registry](https://registry.comfy.org/): Public registry of ComfyUI custom nodes and extensions, with versioning and search.
- [ComfyUI on GitHub](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI): Source repository for the open-source ComfyUI runtime.
- [Comfy-Org on GitHub](https://github.com/Comfy-Org): Organization-wide repositories: frontend, registry, manager, docs, and tooling.
- [comfy-cli on GitHub](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/comfy-cli): Source for the Comfy CLI.
- [comfy-mcp on GitHub](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/comfy-mcp): Source for the Comfy MCP server.
- [comfy-skills on GitHub](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/comfy-skills): Agent skills for image, video, audio, and pipeline work with the Comfy CLI and MCP.

- [Comfy Cloud 自定义节点包](https://comfy.org/zh-CN/cloud/supported-nodes/): Comfy Cloud 预装的自定义节点包，按节点包或节点名搜索。
- [关于我们](https://comfy.org/zh-CN/about/): ComfyUI 背后的团队和使命。
- [招聘](https://comfy.org/zh-CN/careers/): 工程、设计、市场营销等开放岗位。
- [联系我们](https://comfy.org/zh-CN/contact/): 销售、合作与一般咨询。
- [品牌门户](https://comfy.org/zh-CN/brand/): 标志、色彩、字体与语调。
